'''''Andryala integrifolia''''', also known as '''common ''Andryala''''', is a species of flowering plant in the family [[Asteraceae]].<ref name="POWO">{{cite POWO |id=176642-1 |title=''Andryala integrifolia'' |accessdate=7 February 2022}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=Mifsud|first=Stephen|date=2002-08-23|title=''Andryala integrifolia'' (Common ''Andryala'') : MaltaWildPlants.com - the online Flora of the Maltese Islands.|url=https://www.maltawildplants.com/ASTR/Andryala_integrifolia.php|access-date=2022-02-07|website=www.maltawildplants.com|language=en-us}}</ref>
